'''Alin''' is a [[Domani]] soldier under the command of [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Activities ==
During the battle against [[Shadowspawn]] outside [[Maradon]], he is ordered by Ituralde to have his cavalry attack the [[Trolloc]]s eastern flank.
